nav.label: Main
lang.label: Language
home.title: Apply for a fixture benefit
home.intro: This portal helps residents check eligibility and apply for a monthly support benefit.
home.elig.title: Eligibility
home.elig.text: You can apply if you are a resident of the fixture district and are eighteen years or older.
home.docs.title: Documents required
home.docs.text: Keep an identity document and a proof of address ready before you start.
home.fees.title: Fees
home.fees.text: The application is free of cost.
home.steps.title: How to apply
home.steps.text: Fill the online form, upload the documents and submit. You will receive a reference number.
dialog.title: Need help?
dialog.text: Call the helpline from nine to five on working days.
services.title: Our services
services.text: Choose a service to see what it involves and who can use it.
apply.title: Apply online
apply.text: Read the eligibility rules before starting the application form.
help.title: Help and frequently asked questions
help.a1: Most applications are processed within fifteen working days.
contact.title: Contact us
contact.text: Send us a message and we will respond within three working days.
form.name: Full name
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.text: We only use your information to process your application.
a11y.title: Accessibility statement
a11y.text: We aim to meet WCAG 2.2 AA. Report problems using the contact page.
grievance.title: Grievance redressal
grievance.text: If you are unhappy with a decision you can file a complaint with the grievance officer.
media.title: Video guide
media.text: Watch the short video guide. A transcript is available below the video.
